question: 其中的中概股都有哪些？
first_sql: SELECT MAX(t1.TRADE_DATE) AS `最新行情日期`, t2.COMB_SYMBOL AS `股票代码`, t2.CSNAME AS `股票名称` FROM VIEW_US_EOD_EXPR t1 JOIN AMERICAN_STOCK_MAIN t2 ON t1.FIU_ID = t2.FIU_ID WHERE t1.TRADE_DATE = (SELECT MAX(TRADE_DATE) FROM VIEW_US_EOD_EXPR) AND t2.IS_CHINESE_STOCK = '中概股' AND t1.COMB_SYMBOL IS NOT NULL AND t1.FIU_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t2.COMB_SYMBOL, t2.CSNAME
final_sql: SELECT MAX(t1.TRADE_DATE) AS `最新行情日期`, t2.COMB_SYMBOL AS `股票代码`, t2.CSNAME AS `股票名称` FROM VIEW_US_EOD_EXPR t1 JOIN AMERICAN_STOCK_MAIN t2 ON t1.FIU_ID = t2.FIU_ID WHERE t1.TRADE_DATE = (SELECT MAX(TRADE_DATE) FROM VIEW_US_EOD_EXPR) AND t2.IS_CHINESE_STOCK = '中概股' AND t1.COMB_SYMBOL IS NOT NULL AND t1.FIU_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t2.COMB_SYMBOL, t2.CSNAME
